    @import url('');

    .sidebar { background-color: #f8f9fa; padding: 15px; }
    .btn-apply { font-family: 'Roboto Condensed'; font-weight: bold; background-color: #f5e1a2; color: #000; border: 1px solid #ccc; }
    .btn-run { font-family: 'Roboto Condensed'; font-weight: bold; background-color: #DAE8FC; color: #2b384c; border: 1px solid #2b384c; }

# {.sidebar width="350px"}




Target Gene
<hr style="border: none; height: 1px; background-color: #7a7a7a; margin-bottom: 10px;">

{python} ui.row(     ui.column(8, ui.input_text_area("Input_TargetGene", "GENE SYMBOL", value="", height="45px", resize="none")),     ui.column(4, ui.div(style="margin-top: 25px;", ui.input_action_button("Input_GeneSave", "APPLY", class_="btn-apply"))) ) ui.hr() ui.row(     ui.column(6, ui.div(align="center", ui.span("Target Gene", style="font-size: 12px;"), ui.br(), ui.output_text("SELECTED_GENE"))),     ui.column(6, ui.div(align="center", ui.span("Target Type", style="font-size: 12px;"), ui.br(), ui.output_text("SELECTED_TARGET_TYPE"))) ) 

<hr style="border: none; height: 1px; background-color: #000; margin-top: 15px;">
Target Type of Gene

{python} ui.accordion(     ui.accordion_panel("Residue", ui.input_select("Input_TargetResidue", "Amino Acid", choices=[]), ui.input_action_button("Btn_Res", "APPLY", class_="btn-apply")),     ui.accordion_panel("Exon Number", ui.input_select("Input_TargetExon", "Exon", choices=[]), ui.input_action_button("Btn_Ex", "APPLY", class_="btn-apply")),     ui.accordion_panel("RSID", ui.input_text("Input_TargetRSID", "RSID"), ui.input_action_button("Btn_RS", "APPLY", class_="btn-apply")),     id="acc_type", open=False ) 

<hr style="border: none; height: 1px; background-color: #000; margin-top: 15px;">
Genomic Position

{python} ui.accordion(     ui.accordion_panel("Input", ui.input_text("Input_Chrom", "CHR"), ui.row(ui.column(6, ui.input_text("Input_Start", "START")), ui.column(6, ui.input_text("Input_End", "END"))), ui.input_action_button("Btn_P1", "APPLY", class_="btn-apply")),     id="acc_pos", open=False ) 

<hr style="border: none; height: 1px; background-color: #000; margin-top: 15px;">
ANALYSIS RUN

{python} ui.input_switch("Input_UsePos", "Use Genomic Position", False) ui.div(align="center", ui.input_action_button("Input_RUN", "FIND TARGET REGION", icon="dna", class_="btn-run", width="220px")) 

<hr style="border: none; height: 1px; background-color: #000; margin-top: 15px;">
Analysis Result

{python} ui.input_switch("Input_RevComp", "Reverse-Complement", False) ui.input_switch("Input_Lower", "Lowercase Target", False) ui.input_slider("Input_Exp", "Expansion (bp)", 0, 200, 60) ui.input_action_button("Btn_ExpFile", "Export as File", icon="file-export", width="100%") ui.hr() ui.div(align="center", ui.input_action_button("Input_IMP", "IMPORT to PRIMER DESIGN", class_="btn-import", width="250px")) 

# TARGET FINDER

{python} #| context: server @render.text def SELECTED_GENE(): return input.Input_TargetGene() if input.Input_TargetGene() else "-"  @render.text def SELECTED_TARGET_TYPE(): return "-"
